final: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT mt.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) as REAL) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) as REAL) as bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), avg_stats AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_stats) SELECT ms.Name, ms.bytes_per_ms, ms.bytes_per_ms / avg.avg_bytes_per_ms as ratio_to_avg FROM media_stats ms CROSS JOIN avg_stats avg ORDER BY ms.Name
